sourceDecision.evidenceClass: Reuses the recorded consolidation decision and operator-reviewed prototype. Actual release 102 failed mobile containment (390px viewport, 474px document); this correction composes the existing responsive DataTable and filter controls. Corrected served measurements and the original UX coworker/WSID engagements remain owed. This is not a passing sweep or native critique receipt.

rationale.consolidated: Keep the existing routing surface, controls and evidence. Reflow labeled traffic/evaluation/catalog rows through report-kit's responsive API, keep identifying task/model cells together, and compose the same four filters in two narrow-screen columns with 44px targets.
rationale.add-dashboard: A separate mobile dashboard or table implementation duplicates state, evidence presentation and navigation. Hiding overflow or dropping columns would conceal the observed failure rather than repair it.
